name: UI Cards on Grid
description: Dark navy grid with drifting dust and a top HUD of labeled progress bars. A big two-line header (white line + accent line) sits in the upper third, and each scene is a set of flat UI cards with soft depth: social post cards with a highlighter sweep and a magnifier, bar chart cards with a dashed 'expected' outline, a jar that fills, an hourglass, price tags hanging from strings, a yellow stat badge, a timer display, rotated stamps and side-by-side comparison panels. Word-box captions and a handle at the bottom. Clear, analytical, internet-native. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 short scenes (3-5 s each) that explain one change, deal or claim step by step. title.kicker is the white first line (e.g. HASTA HOY:, OJO A LA, EL PRECIO) and title.main the accent second line (max ~22 chars). Use 1-2 elements per scene from: post (the original announcement, highlight the key line, magnify true), chart (values with expected for 'what you thought you got'), meter (jar that fills; stamp IGUAL to say nothing changed), hourglass (waiting), tags (prices), stat (one big figure), timer (countdowns like 4:59:59, countdown true), panels (two options with a tag each, winner index), stamp over an element by id. Fill hud.items with a chip and two bars (e.g. TANDA 5 H, SEMANA) and change their values per scene. Never use emoji.
